title: Probabilistic Reasoning and Bayesian Networks
overview: Reason under uncertainty using probability, Bayes' rule, and graphical models that encode conditional independence.
objectives: Read a Bayesian network's structure and factorization

method.title: Bayes' rule
method.body: P(H|E) = P(E|H)P(H)/P(E) updates beliefs when evidence arrives.

method.title: Bayesian networks
method.body: A directed acyclic graph with conditional probability tables factorizes a joint distribution compactly.

method.title: Conditional independence
method.body: A node is independent of its non-descendants given its parents, which cuts the number of parameters.

method.title: Inference
method.body: Exact inference uses enumeration or variable elimination, while approximate methods use sampling.

playground.starterCode:
p_d = 0.01; sens = 0.9; fpr = 0.05
p_pos = sens*p_d + fpr*(1-p_d)
print(round(sens*p_d/p_pos, 3))

options: A DAG with conditional probability tables
